scope_notes.text: A 2024 title and Effective -2024 heading coexist with an unlabeled 8/18/2026 footer; their source roles remain distinct.
The eight valuation rows retain their complete ranges and incremental-fee language. Other fees preserve payment timing, minimum durations, separate charges and linked cost footnotes.
Sales-tax and temporary-electrical headings are linked to their own later native bodies; their conditions and rates remain separate.
Memo date, claimed methodology adoption, EAF data periods and stated fee effective date are distinct source claims; no current-law determination is made.
EAF interleaving and Transportation column-major extraction require explicit visual cell mapping. Page 3 carries numeric headings from page 2.
General rounding wording, printed decimal Storm Drainage rates and a separate future utility-adoption statement are preserved without repair or adoption inference.
The notice date is November 20, 2020, with prospective Board review on December 16, 2020. March 1, 2021 is conditional on adoption; the schedule heading alone does not establish adoption.
Seven tap-size rows and a separate single-family row remain separate tables, with their exact headers, blank first header and four printed dollar-sign cells preserved.
Greeley issuer and utility context remain distinct from Weld County contractor recipients. The body and image-only footer retain different contact numbers.

portability_limits: Only the package wrapper is a portable execution entry point. Archived construction scripts and their original absolute paths are preserved as evidence, not executed.
The wrapper resolves required historical input paths to frozen copies; it does not require the original workspace, canonical raw paths, live website or Git checkout.

Original full HTTP headers are represented by their recorded identities, while the packet contains exact previously derived copies with Set-Cookie lines omitted. No claim is made that full header bytes are packaged.
The frozen raw-manifest snapshot includes unrelated intake records; only the three selected record lines are used to establish these source identities.
Rerender equality requires the declared Poppler version. Visual findings remain the scoped prior Atlas inspections, not automatically proven legal conclusions.
downstream_limits: These are three source reviews, not current or adopted fee rules, executable calculators or a complete Greeley fee framework.
No external Ebenezer review has been intaken. The three source audits are candidate-aware and must not be relabeled blind independent reviews.
Source dates, fees, conditions, anomalies and graphic-only wording remain in their original audits. No new arithmetic, harmonization or cross-document applicability inference is performed.
